department: Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences & VIMS

deadline.value: The online application, with transcripts, letters and fee, is due December 1, 2026; no late applications are accepted.
deadline.quote: December 1, 2026 - Deadline for submission of the online application, this includes

app_fee.value: The Batten School charges a $44 non-refundable application fee, not the Arts & Sciences $50.

fee_waiver.value: The Batten School says a fee can be waived but does not say who qualifies.
fee_waiver.quote: The application is not complete until the fee has been paid or waived

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and are not used to rank applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission to the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for this program, so no subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission to the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences

toefl_min.value: The Batten School recommends a TOEFL iBT score of at least 94 for admission.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 94 or a score of 7 on the IELTS is recommended for admission

ielts_min.value: The Batten School recommends an IELTS Academic score of 7 for admission.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 94 or a score of 7 on the IELTS is recommended for admission

english_waiver.value: Only a North American undergraduate degree is exempt, so an Indian degree does not waive the TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants whose native language is not English must submit a TOEFL or IELTS score | An exception to this rule is the international student who has earned an undergraduate degree at a North American university

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact a faculty advisor, who must confirm space and funding, before applying.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students for the M.S. or Ph.D. programs must identify and contact a potential faculty advisor to verify if space and funding is available before submitting their application

funding.value: Most PhD students are supported through their advisor's research grants plus institutional support.
funding.quote: Graduate students pursuing the M.S. or Ph.D. degree are most commonly supported through a combination of research grants to their advisor supplemented with institutional support

entry_route.value: The PhD requires a master's degree; a bachelor's-only applicant can apply through the M.S.-to-PhD bypass track.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. applicants must complete a Master's degree from an accredited institution | Students interested in pursuing our M.S. to Ph.D. bypass track need only to have completed a Bachelor's degree

notes: Marine Science PhD (42 credits, 4-6 years) run by the Batten School & VIMS, a separate school with its own application, fee ($44), GRE rule and English rule. Admission is tied to a named faculty advisor. The school's rules are recorded as overrides of the graduate-school record.
name: Marine Science, Ph.D.
